item.description:

item.title: I want extern "fil-C"
item.description:
📝 I want a Rust FFI that speaks the Fil-C ABI. Shared memory could come later, once the bridge can give Fil-C a capability that Rust can reliably revoke. Rust has compile-time safety.
🔗 Read more: https://domenkozar.com/2026/08/13/i-want-extern-fil-c/

item.title: Blog about things you don't understand yet
item.description:
📝 I never publish a post that just gives some scattered thoughts on a topic, or a post that only says “yes, I agree with this other article”. This should be obvious when you actually think about it. You should be researching and thinking about every post you write, and that means you should frequently learn new things that change your mind.
🔗 Read more: https://www.seangoedecke.com/blog-about-things-you-dont-understand-yet/
